The prose that follows is the stored account, kept as the account of the part that holds. || LANDED 2026-09-04 (PB207; PB184 landed the alphanumeric half). ONE area rule, GroupValueSlicer.AreaOf, ridden by BOTH initializer lanes - the typed-native record-struct fields and GroupImageCodec.ImageInitOf, the seeder for every character-image backing (Tier-B REDEFINES, EXTERNAL cells, BASED/ADDRESS-OF cells, OO backings) - so the deposit cannot differ between them. The area is composed in the unit the GROUP's own storage is measured in and the rule reports which: m BOOLEAN POSITIONS for a bit group (13.18.29.4 GR1 b) makes it an as-if PICTURE 1(m) item and GR1 c) lays its members out per 8.5.1.6.3), ImageWidth CHARACTER positions otherwise. GR7's 14.6.8 arm follows the receiving CATEGORY: 14.6.8.6 zero fill / right truncation for a boolean area, 14.6.8.5 space fill for alphanumeric and national. All three operand forms are area fills under 8.3.3.6.4 GR2 (quoted literal, ALL literal-1, figurative word). The complement of GR5's conforming population is diagnosed, not silently deposited: 13.18.63.3 SR14 (COBOL1702) refuses a non-DISPLAY subordinate under an alphanumeric group item carrying a VALUE, which is why a positional deposit needs no character/byte reconciliation there. EDITIONS: GR5's text is edition-invariant; the 85 witness is conformance:cases/13.18.63-VALUE/pb207_group_value_area_85 (neither 2002+ pin can stand at 85 - one writes TYPEDEF/TYPE, the other GROUP-USAGE), and the bit and national arms are gated by their own 2002 constructs (COBOL0900).
